matched.title: Deposit completion skips the asset check, so a worthless token paid to the anchor marks a deposit as funds sent

findings.title: Deposit completion skips the asset check, so a worthless token paid to the anchor marks a deposit as funds sent
SAC-to-asset mapping trusts the RPC entry without binding it to the requested contract ID, and caches the result forever
Soroban RPC payment observer cannot restart after a stream or silence error and stops for good
Soroban RPC observer advances cursor past events whose listener notification failed, so they are never retried
Contract-call transfer detection only inspects the first asset balance change, so deposits at later indexes are missed
Ambiguous memo matches drop the payment with no retry, hold or refund
Horizon observer skips observed payments when restarted more than 200 network payments behind
Payment listeners swallow failures, then the cursor advances, so failed notifications are never retried
Soroban SAC lookups are not negatively cached, so any contract's transfer-shaped event costs the observer RPC calls on every event
Observer gate uses event topic addresses that are not bound to the credited ledger operation
Amount and asset cross-check is not independent on the Soroban RPC path
IOException from the platform notify falls through to SEP-24 and SEP-6 routing with the same memo
Memo lookup ignores memo type, so a text memo can match an ID-memo transaction
Horizon restart crashes with NumberFormatException when the latest cursor fetch fails
SAC metadata lookup assumes a ledger entry exists and throws an unchecked exception
Reloaded observed accounts lose RESIDENTIAL status and can be evicted, including distribution accounts
Status watcher dies on any non-Transaction exception during observer restart, leaving the observer in an error state for good
Soroban RPC silence watchdog is reset by any successful getEvents response, so a stalled ledger feed is never detected
Any network user can stall the Horizon observer with a transfer-named contract call that has no asset balance changes
Shared SAC-to-asset HashMap is accessed from two observer threads without synchronization
